E0437

`<>` is outside a pipe step or an `if` table header

What

`<>` is outside a pipe step or an `if` table header

Why

`<>` is the value a `|> step` receives from the line above, or the place each arm's candidate takes in an `if` table header; here it is neither

Fix

Move it into a step such as `value |> f(<>)`, or write the value itself

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0437: Tests/UI/pipe_value_outside_step.stderr.

    |           ^^

 Fix: Move it into a step such as `value |> f(<>)`, or write the value itself
